claim: For the real regular octagonal plane \(X=(\mathbb R^2,N)\), where \(N(x,y)=\max\{|x|,|y|,(|x|+|y|)/\sqrt2\}\), the Ptolemy constant is exactly \(C_{\mathrm{Pt}}(X)=4-2\sqrt2\).
integrity: The proof is self-contained: a complete sharp Euclidean norm comparison yields the upper bound and a symbolic three-point configuration yields equality. Literature comparisons separate inspected implications from access-limited uncertainty.
scientific_limitations: The equality is proved only for the real regular octagonal plane. A 2015 paper on additional sufficient conditions for planar Ptolemy constants could not be inspected in full, leaving an explicit originality access residual. A prior ledger result computes a Banach--Mazur invariant for a larger octagonal family containing this space, but it does not contain the present sharp Ptolemy lower bound.
title: Exact Ptolemy constant of the regular octagonal plane
